```yaml
name: Test Count Badge

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-test-count:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt || true

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Count test functions
        run: |
          python scripts/count_tests.py > test-stats.json
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Generate badge JSON
        id: badge
        run: |
          TOTAL=$(jq -r '.total_tests' test-stats.json)
          echo "total=$TOTAL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "{\"schemaVersion\":1,\"label\":\"tests\",\"message\":\"$TOTAL\",\"color\":\"blue\"}" > badge.json

      - name: Update README with badge
        run: |
          # Ensure a placeholder exists
          PLACEHOLDER="<!-- test-count-badge -->"
          if ! grep -q "$PLACEHOLDER" README.md; then
            echo -e "\n$PLACEHOLDER" >> README.md
          fi
          # Replace placeholder with badge image
          sed -i "s|$PLACEHOLDER|![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-${{ steps.badge.outputs.total }}-blue)|" README.md

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v5
        with:
          commit_message: "Update test count badge"
          file_pattern: README.md test-stats.json badge.json
```
